purpose: Person sample scenes selected by conditional balancing of feasible backgrounds, counts and standee angles.
independence_basis: Sample backgrounds retain their source groups; foregrounds are flat standee artworks.

design.background_fit: preserve 640x360 image with 60 pixel top and bottom padding
design.view_basis: front-source flat standee rotated in plane projection, not a real side-view portrait
design.placement_basis: GroundSpace on recorded ground polygon clipped to local visible-floor estimates; configured far scale 0.70, not calibrated 3-D

occlusion.upper_foreground_basis: top quarter of original foreground; geometric proxy, not semantic face detection
